knoxchat.showInlineTip.description: Show inline suggestions for Knox shortcuts (e.g., "Cmd/Ctrl L to add code to chat, Cmd/Ctrl I to edit code")

knoxchat.enableInlineCompletions.markdownDescription: Use the configured Knox model for ghost-text inline completions (separate from chat). Off by default.

knoxchat.inlineCompletionModel.markdownDescription: Model title to use for inline completions, e.g. a small fast model. Empty = the edit model, then the chat model.

knoxchat.enablePostEditVerification.markdownDescription: After mutating tool calls (create/edit/generate tests), automatically check diagnostics and attempt LLM fixes. Applies to both chat and agent mode. Ignored when `knoxchat.verifyCommand` is set or `knoxchat.agentProfile` is `systems` / `rust` (compile oracle).

knoxchat.agentProfile.markdownDescription: Agent loop profile. `default`: unlimited tool rounds, LSP verify. `systems`: unlimited rounds, doom-loop 5, post-edit `make` oracle (kernel/QEMU). `rust`: unlimited rounds, doom-loop 4, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`. `auto`: systems on Kconfig+arch / QEMU meson+target, rust on a root Cargo.toml. Stop a run with Cancel.

knoxchat.jev.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable Jev (System One) harness judgments: model routing, skill hints, passage/tool gates, citation checks, and `auto` profile confirm. Uses the KnoxStudio API key on your knoxchat models (OAuth session or yaml). Optional `jev.apiKey` override. Always calls https://api.knoxstudio.ai/v1/systemone. Fail-open to current heuristics. YAML `jev.enabled` overrides this.

knoxchat.jev.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show a status bar indicator whenever Jev (System One) calls are made, with a log of every call. Jev sends only the user message, short recent-turn summaries, tool names/argument previews and truncated assistant text for judgments; never file contents. Each call has a hard latency budget (gates 800 ms, others 2 s) and a circuit breaker (3 consecutive failures skip Jev for 5 minutes). Click the indicator to open the Jev log.

knoxchat.memoryBrain.maxBytes.markdownDescription: Cap on Memory Brain `brain.sqlite` (plus WAL) in bytes. Oldest episodic turns are pruned when the cap is exceeded; curated facts are kept. `0` disables. Environment variable `KNOX_BRAIN_MAX_BYTES` overrides this. Enforced on open and on each consolidation tick.

knoxchat.memoryBrain.enabled.markdownDescription: Global switch for Memory Brain. Off skips retrieval, auto-consolidation, and new writes. Existing `brain.sqlite` is left on disk. `KNOX_BRAIN_ENABLED=0` overrides this.

knoxchat.memoryBrain.workspaceEnabled.markdownDescription: Per-workspace Memory Brain. Off for this folder only (workspace setting). Use this to opt a repo out of local memory.

knoxchat.sandbox.markdownDescription: OS sandbox for Auto-mode shell. `workspace-write` limits writes to the workspace and temp dirs; `read-only` also makes the workspace read-only. macOS uses `sandbox-exec`, Linux uses `bwrap`. Windows has no wrapper (the composer shows that). `KNOX_SANDBOX` overrides this; `KNOX_SANDBOX_REQUIRED=1` fails closed if the backend is missing.

knoxchat.networkMode.markdownDescription: Network policy shared by `builtin_fetch_url` and the shell sandbox. `deny` blocks fetch_url and takes the sandbox off the network; `allowlist` restricts fetch_url to `knoxchat.networkAllowlist` (shell still has no network in the sandbox). `KNOX_NETWORK_MODE` overrides this.

knoxchat.networkAllowlist.markdownDescription: Hostnames allowed when `knoxchat.networkMode` is `allowlist` (exact or `*.suffix`). `KNOX_NETWORK_ALLOWLIST` is a comma-separated override.

knoxchat.compatInstructions.markdownDescription: Opt-in extra project instructions: `cursor` loads `.cursor/rules` and `.cursorrules`; `copilot` loads `.github/copilot-instructions.md`. They sit below `AGENTS.md`. `KNOX_COMPAT_INSTRUCTIONS=cursor,copilot` overrides this.

knoxchat.fallbackModel.markdownDescription: Optional model title to switch to when the main model keeps failing with transient errors (429, 5xx, network) during a native chat turn. Empty = never switch.

knoxchat.deferTools.markdownDescription: Send only the core tools each turn and let the agent load the rest (memory, git, systems, and so on) through `builtin_tool_search`. Cuts tool-schema tokens by more than half (live eval: 51k vs 122k prompt tokens per task, same pass rate).

knoxchat.verifyCommand.markdownDescription: Incremental build to run after Agent file edits (compile oracle). Example: `make -j8` or `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`. When set, LSP post-edit verification is skipped. Empty = LSP diagnostics (default for TS/JS).

knoxchat.verifyMode.markdownDescription: Post-edit oracle: `diagnostics` (LSP), `command` (`knoxchat.verifyCommand` / make), or `off`. A non-empty verifyCommand selects `command`.

knoxchat.verifyMaxIterations.markdownDescription: Skip further auto-builds after this many identical compiler error signatures (circuit breaker).

knoxchat.enableShadowPreview.markdownDescription: Before applying a chat edit to an existing non-empty file, show a side-by-side shadow diff. Accept continues the normal vertical-diff apply path; Reject discards the proposal. Files over 4000 lines skip shadow unless `knoxchat.shadowPreviewLargeFiles` is true.

knoxchat.shadowPreviewLargeFiles.markdownDescription: Allow shadow preview on files larger than 4000 lines. Default off so 10k-line C files use the vertical diff / apply_patch preview instead.

knox.checkpoints.maxStorageBytes.description: Maximum disk usage for checkpoint blobs and manifests (bytes). Oldest unpinned checkpoints are folded and deleted when the cap is exceeded.

knox.checkpoints.maxFilesPerCheckpoint.description: Warn when a checkpoint captures more files than this. Files are never silently dropped — truncation would make restore incomplete.

knox.checkpoints.maxFileSizeBytes.description: Maximum size of a single file captured in snapshots (bytes)

knox.checkpoints.captureBinaryFiles.description: Snapshot binary files (images, fonts, PDFs, …) as base64 so they can be restored and compared

knox.checkpoints.enableCompression.description: Gzip checkpoint file blobs larger than 4KB. Restore always round-trips the original bytes.

knox.checkpoints.encryptAtRest.markdownDescription: Encrypt checkpoint blob files on disk with AES-GCM. The key is stored in the OS keychain (VS Code Secret Storage), never in the workspace. Manifests still list file paths. Enable compression is applied before encryption.

knox.checkpoints.enableAutoCheckpoints.markdownDescription: Create a checkpoint after AI conversation turns when workspace files changed. Default is **true**. Independent of time/file-threshold auto-checkpoints (`knox.checkpoints.auto.enabled`).

knox.checkpoints.auto.enabled.description: Enable time- and file-threshold automatic checkpoints

knox.checkpoints.auto.maxIntervalMs.description: Force an automatic checkpoint after this interval when files have changed (milliseconds)

knox.checkpoints.auto.fileChangeThreshol.description: Create an automatic checkpoint after this many file changes

knox.checkpoints.auto.checkpointAfterAI.description: Create an automatic checkpoint when an AI operation completes

knox.checkpoints.auto.checkpointBeforeRi.description: Create an automatic checkpoint before mutating/risky tool operations

knox.checkpoints.auto.showNotifications.description: Show a notification when an automatic checkpoint is created

knox.checkpoints.auto.debounceMs.description: Debounce file-change events before evaluating automatic checkpoints (milliseconds)

knox.checkpoints.smart.enabled.description: Enable the smart AI-session checkpoint tracker

knox.checkpoints.smart.agentModeOnly.description: Only track AI-session files while Agent mode is active

knox.checkpoints.smart.maxTrackedFiles.description: Maximum files tracked in a smart AI session

knox.checkpoints.smart.maxMemoryUsageMB.description: Memory budget for smart AI-session tracking (MB)

knox.checkpoints.smart.maxCheckpoints.description: Maximum checkpoints retained for a smart AI session

knox.checkpoints.smart.maxFileSizeKB.description: Skip files larger than this in smart AI-session tracking (KB)

knox.checkpoints.smart.verboseLogging.description: Verbose logging for smart AI-session checkpoints

knox.checkpoints.smart.enableMetrics.description: Record AI-session file, line, and rollback metrics on the Checkpoints dashboard

knox.checkpoints.inlineDiff.enabled.description: Show gutter and inline decorations comparing the open editor to a checkpoint (last checkpoint, or one picked via Show Inline Diff)

knox.checkpoints.inlineDiff.showLineDeco.description: Highlight changed lines when inline checkpoint diff is enabled

knox.checkpoints.inlineDiff.showGutterIc.description: Show gutter icons for checkpoint diffs

knox.checkpoints.inlineDiff.showHoverPre.description: Show hover previews of original checkpoint content

knox.checkpoints.inlineDiff.showCodeLens.description: Show CodeLens actions for checkpoint inline diffs

knox.checkpoints.inlineDiff.highlightWor.description: Highlight word-level changes inside modified lines
